Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Twifo Praso clash: One dead, police deploy 100 officers after anti-drug raid Source : Myjoyonline.com 27 November 2026 4:26am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
A police operation targeting suspected drug hideouts at Twifo Praso in the Central Region has ended in violence, leaving one civilian dead, several others injured, and three police officers hurt.
The fatality was one of two men reportedly shot when officers from the Police Intelligence Directorate (PID) of the Central North Regional Police Command encountered resistance during an operation near the Pra River on Thursday, November 26.
The exercise was intended to dismantle makeshift structures believed to be used for drug-related activities as part of an intensified campaign against narcotics trafficking and consumption in the area.
Tensions flared after some suspects were arrested, prompting a group of youth to confront the officers.
The confrontation reportedly escalated when two individuals allegedly attempted to set fire to a police pickup vehicle. Officers subsequently fired gunshots to disperse the crowd, hitting the two men.
They were taken to the Twifo Praso Government Hospital, where one was later pronounced dead.
The violence did not end with the shooting. A group of angry youth reportedly besieged the Twifo Praso Police Station, while some protesters vandalised the facility, damaging its glass windows.
The disturbances also left some police personnel injured, with reports indicating that officers had been pelted with stones during the confrontation.
In response, the police deployed 100 additional officers to the town to contain the situation and prevent further violence.
